_how_to_update: Edit this file on GitHub (pencil icon). Each list is independent. Add an item by copying an existing one. Keep 'last_checked' honest — it shows on the site. Eat/drink/do entries need: name, area (city), hood, kind, why, known_for, address, website, lat, lon, reviews (Google Maps search link). Markets need: name, area, hood, kind, when, season, address, website, lat, lon. Festivals need: name, area, place, kind, usually, latest, start/end (ISO, or null), url, month (1-12).

developments.name: Universal Kids Resort
developments.summary: Universal's first theme park designed for families with young kids, with a themed hotel, at the Fields area of Frisco.

developments.name: Fields West
developments.summary: Shops, dining, offices and residences on the west side of the Fields development, near the PGA of America headquarters.

developments.name: 2027 PGA Championship at Fields Ranch
developments.summary: One of golf's four majors comes to PGA Frisco's Fields Ranch course.

developments.name: Grand Park, Phase I
developments.summary: The first $43M phase of Frisco's long-planned central park, including the Civic Room.

developments.name: Toyota Stadium renovation
developments.timing: West and north sides closed from fall 2026; target is FC Dallas' first 2028 home match
developments.summary: A major rebuild of FC Dallas' home stadium, with an entertainment district and hotel planned nearby.

developments.name: Frisco Rail District downtown reinvestment
developments.summary: An $83M upgrade to Frisco's historic downtown streets and public spaces.

developments.name: Collin Creek redevelopment
developments.summary: The former Collin Creek Mall site is becoming homes, apartments, retail and two new parks. About 200 households already live there.

developments.name: Sapphire Bay
developments.timing: City issued a notice of default to the developer in January 2026
developments.summary: A planned lakefront resort district on Lake Ray Hubbard. Apartments and homes are built, but the promised resort, lagoon and commercial core remain undeveloped.

developments.name: Kay Bailey Hutchison Convention Center rebuild
developments.timing: Demolition of Halls D, E and F began February 2026, expected substantially complete by end of 2026; overall completion targeted for 2029
developments.summary: Dallas is replacing most of its downtown convention center with a larger facility; Halls A, B and C stay open during construction. The city expects the work to free up more than 30 acres for housing, hotels, retail and dining.

developments.name: Panther Island canal and bridges (Phase 1)
developments.timing: Canal C scheduled for completion in early 2028; new North Commerce and Calhoun Street bridges in final design, with completion listed for spring 2029
developments.summary: Part of the Panther Island waterfront district north of downtown Fort Worth. The city will build two bridges over the new canal once the water district finishes it.

developments.name: Anthem (Lincoln Square redevelopment)
developments.timing: Broke ground August 3, 2026; completion expected early 2028
developments.summary: A 43-acre redo of the former Lincoln Square shopping center in north Arlington, with about 404,000 sq ft of retail, dining and entertainment space plus a public green.

developments.name: Sunset Amphitheater
developments.timing: About 70% complete as of October 2026; expected to open in 2027
developments.summary: A 20,000-seat outdoor concert venue near US 75 and SH 121, developed by Venu.

developments.name: Mixed-use project near Grapevine Mills
developments.timing: Approved by Grapevine City Council June 2, 2026; developer hoped to obtain building permits in summer 2026
developments.summary: A 28.7-acre Trammell Crow Company project with up to 248 apartments and a 222-room Sandman Signature Hotel near Grapevine Mills.
